column3: Exercise 1: plank (mistake: hips sagging). Exercise 2: dead bug. Art style: isometric low-poly 3D illustration, soft pastel lighting, white background. Voice: ash.
Exercise 1: dead hang (mistake: shoulders shrugged up to the ears). Exercise 2: scapular pull-ups. Art style: Japanese ukiyo-e woodblock print, textured washi paper. Voice: echo.
Exercise 1: wall angels (mistake: lower back arched off the wall). Exercise 2: chin tucks against the wall. Art style: chalk drawing on a dark green school chalkboard. Voice: cedar.

Exercise 1: cobra stretch (mistake: shoulders shrugged and hips lifted off the floor). Exercise 2: child's pose. Art style: neon line art glowing on a black background, synthwave colors. Voice: verse.
Exercise 1: glute bridge (mistake: overarching the lower back at the top). Exercise 2: hip flexor lunge stretch. Art style: kids crayon drawing on white paper, playful and messy. Voice: coral.
Exercise 1: standing forward fold (mistake: rounding the back and locking the knees). Exercise 2: cat-cow. Art style: paper craft layered cut-paper diorama with soft shadows. Voice: sage.

Exercise 1: chin tuck (mistake: tilting the head down instead of gliding it straight back). Exercise 2: neck side stretch. Art style: clean medical infographic illustration, blue and white, subtle anatomy lines. Voice: marin.
Exercise 1: bird dog (mistake: hips rotating and back sagging). Exercise 2: superman hold. Art style: retro 1970s fitness poster, grainy print, orange and brown palette. Voice: ballad.

Exercise 1: standing posture (mistake: slumped shoulders, head forward, weight on one hip). Exercise 2: overhead reach with heels raises. Art style: bold sticker illustration with thick white borders on a bright teal background. Voice: alloy.

Exercise 1: seated hamstring stretch (mistake: rounded back reaching with the hands). Exercise 2: standing hip hinge good morning. Art style: realistic oil painting, warm studio light, dark brown background. Voice: echo.
